# altr_classifier_collection (Resource)

Manages a classifier collection. Collections group classifiers together for use in classification jobs and agent tasks. Manage membership with the `altr_classifier_collection_classifier` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) ALTR Solutions, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

resource "altr_classifier_collection" "pii" {
  name        = "pii_collection"
  description = "PII and sensitive data classifiers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name for the collection. Names starting with 'ALTR' are reserved. Changing the name forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the collection. Must be non-empty when set: the update API ignores empty descriptions, so a description can be changed but not cleared.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Collection identifier (same as name).
